report.summary: Puratos receives a global claims-risk score of 50/100. Green risk is 51/100 and social risk is 49/100. The main retained issues concern climate-neutrality wording, certification terminology and broad environmental claims.

fallback_note: Company name Puratos was resolved to www.puratos.com via web search. Verify that this is the correct entity before relying on the result.

reasons: At least the main company page was reviewed.
External public-source search returned several results.

entity_context_indicator.note: One external public-source signal was retained and may be relevant to claim credibility, subject to manual verification. Sector exposure is High because of complex supply chains and labour-risk exposure.

claim_inventory.claim_text: Puratos marks major sustainability milestone with carbon neutral operations.
claim_inventory.why_flagged: The wording may imply complete neutrality without making the emissions boundary, residual emissions and role of offsets clear.
claim_inventory.suggested_rewrite: Avoid product-level neutrality wording based on offsets. Separate actual emissions reductions from offsets and disclose scopes, baseline, methodology, residual emissions and progress.

claim_inventory.claim_text: While reducing our own emissions is our primary goal, we are also committed to taking proactive steps to remove carbon from the atmosphere. That is why we have chosen to plant trees in our value chain, particularly through Cacao-Trace, our own certified sustainable cocoa sourcing program.
claim_inventory.why_flagged: The wording may be understood as an independent sustainability certification.
claim_inventory.suggested_rewrite: Name the scheme owner, criteria, independence, audit basis, scope and validity period. Remove self-declared labels or clarify them as non-certification claims.

claim_inventory.claim_text: With our innovative bakery solutions, we support you in creating nutritious and more sustainable breads that deliver mouth-watering taste and texture to your consumers.
claim_inventory.why_flagged: The comparative benefit and environmental attribute are not clear from the wording alone.
claim_inventory.suggested_rewrite: Specify the exact attribute, product or material scope, baseline, method, evidence, reporting period and limitations.

claim_inventory.claim_text: We protect human rights across our supply chain.
claim_inventory.why_flagged: The wording implies broad control across the supply chain.
claim_inventory.suggested_rewrite: Specify supplier tiers, coverage, due-diligence process, findings, remediation and limitations.

company_action_plan.title: Review client-facing green claims under EmpCo
company_action_plan.action: Check the exact wording Puratos uses for the detected green claim areas on websites, product pages and folders. For each claim, document scope, product coverage, methodology, evidence source, verification basis and limitations before reuse.

company_action_plan.title: Substantiate high-priority social claims
company_action_plan.action: For Puratos's detected social claim areas, collect stakeholder scope, KPIs, grievance and remedy evidence, audit or workforce data and clear limits to avoid overstatement.

company_action_plan.title: Build a claim evidence file
company_action_plan.action: Create one evidence file per priority claim retained in this scan, with the approved wording, source URL or document, owner, evidence link, date, legal or compliance review status and review deadline.

targeted_negative_sources.title: Warehouse, Processing and Distribution Workers Union Local 26 (Puratos Bakery Supply, Inc.)
targeted_negative_sources.content: An official US government case record involving Puratos Bakery Supply, Inc. The signal requires manual verification before use.

targeted_negative_sources.title: Regulator reviews environmental marketing claims by the company
targeted_negative_sources.content: The authority opened a review into whether selected environmental claims provided consumers with sufficiently clear and substantiated information.
